CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION warehouse.stock_conversion_workspace(payload jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if auth.uid() is null or not (coalesce(core.has_live_cap('warehouse','manage_returns'),false) or coalesce(core.has_live_cap('warehouse','inspect_quality'),false)) then raise exception 'Not authorized to view stock conversion work'; end if;
  return jsonb_build_object(
    'recipes',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(r order by approved_at desc) from (select * from private.stock_conversion_recipes order by approved_at desc limit 200) r),'[]'::jsonb),
    'batches',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(b order by created_at desc) from (select * from private.stock_conversion_batches order by created_at desc limit 200) b),'[]'::jsonb),
    'candidates',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(candidate) from (
      select u.id unit_id,u.serial_number,u.product_id,u.location_id,u.bin_id,q.id inspection_id,
        case when q.source_type='return' then q.source_id end return_id,
        (select line->>'allocationId' from warehouse.returns r cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(r.lines) line
          where r.id=q.source_id and q.source_type='return' and line->>'serialNumber'=u.serial_number limit 1) allocation_id,
        (select l.batch_id from private.stock_conversion_lines l join private.stock_conversion_batches b on b.id=l.batch_id
          join private.stock_conversion_recipes r on r.id=b.recipe_id where l.unit_id=u.id and l.output_product_id=u.product_id and r.direction='conversion'
            and not exists(select 1 from private.stock_conversion_lines recovered where recovered.original_conversion_id=l.batch_id and recovered.unit_id=l.unit_id)
          order by b.completed_at desc limit 1) original_conversion_id
      from warehouse.inventory_units u join lateral (
        select * from warehouse.quality_inspections q where q.serial_number=u.serial_number and q.product_id=u.product_id
        order by q.inspected_at desc limit 1
      ) q on q.disposition='accepted' and coalesce(private.stock_conversion_qc_matches(u,q,null,true),false)
      where u.status='in_stock' and u.assigned_to is null and u.bin_id is not null
      order by u.serial_number limit 500
    ) candidate),'[]'::jsonb),
    'recovery_available',to_regprocedure('private.assert_event_conversion_return(text,text,text,text,text)') is not null);
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.warehouse_inventory_position_summary()
 RETURNS TABLE(id text, product_id text, location_id text, bin_id text, on_hand bigint, committed bigint, held bigint, unavailable bigint, available bigint, created_at timestamp with time zone, unscoped_committed bigint, product_available bigint, availability_verified boolean, putaway_available bigint)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare v_table text; v_relation regclass; v_auth oid;
begin
  if auth.uid() is null or (
    core.has_live_cap('warehouse','view_inventory')
    or core.has_live_cap('warehouse','view_analytics')
    or core.has_live_cap('warehouse','view_finance')
    or core.has_live_cap('insights','view_warehouse')
  ) is not true then
    raise exception using errcode='42501',message='Current inventory summary read access is required';
  end if;
  select oid into strict v_auth from pg_catalog.pg_roles where rolname='authenticated';
  foreach v_table in array array['products','locations','storage_areas','stock_levels','inventory_units'] loop
    v_relation:=pg_catalog.to_regclass('warehouse.'||v_table);
    if not exists(select 1 from pg_catalog.pg_policy p
      where p.polrelid=v_relation and p.polcmd='r' and p.polpermissive
        and (v_auth=any(p.polroles) or 0=any(p.polroles))
        and pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(p.polqual,p.polrelid)='true')
      or not exists(select 1 from pg_catalog.pg_policy p
        where p.polrelid=v_relation and p.polcmd='r' and not p.polpermissive
          and v_auth=any(p.polroles) and p.polname='current_capability_read_guard')
      or exists(select 1 from pg_catalog.pg_policy p
        where p.polrelid=v_relation and p.polcmd in ('r','*') and not p.polpermissive
          and (v_auth=any(p.polroles) or 0=any(p.polroles))
          and (p.polname<>'current_capability_read_guard'
            or pg_catalog.regexp_replace(pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(p.polqual,p.polrelid),'\s+',' ','g')
              <>pg_catalog.format('( SELECT private.can_read_warehouse_table(%L::text) AS can_read_warehouse_table)',v_table))) then
      raise exception using errcode='42501',message='Inventory summary row scope changed; review the summary read policy';
    end if;
  end loop;
  return query
  with active_holds as materialized (
    select h.product_id,h.location_id,h.bin_id,h.lot_id,h.serial_number,h.quantity
    from warehouse.inventory_holds h where h.status='active'
  ), unverifiable_products as (
    -- Unknown serial overlap invalidates this product, not the whole read.
    select distinct h.product_id from active_holds h join warehouse.products p on p.id=h.product_id
    where p.serialized and (nullif(btrim(h.serial_number),'') is null or h.quantity<>1)
  ), held_serials as (
    select distinct h.product_id,upper(btrim(h.serial_number)) as serial_number
    from active_holds h where h.serial_number is not null
  ), bulk_holds as (
    select h.product_id,h.location_id,h.bin_id,h.lot_id,sum(h.quantity)::bigint as quantity
    from active_holds h join warehouse.products p on p.id=h.product_id and not p.serialized
    group by h.product_id,h.location_id,h.bin_id,h.lot_id
  ), bulk_levels as (
    select s.product_id,s.location_id,s.bin_id,s.lot_id,sum(s.quantity)::bigint as quantity
    from warehouse.stock_levels s group by s.product_id,s.location_id,s.bin_id,s.lot_id
  ), physical as (
    select s.product_id,s.location_id,s.bin_id,s.quantity as on_hand,
      least(greatest(s.quantity,0),coalesce(h.quantity,0))::bigint as held,0::bigint as unavailable
    from bulk_levels s left join bulk_holds h on h.product_id=s.product_id and h.location_id=s.location_id
      and h.bin_id is not distinct from s.bin_id and h.lot_id is not distinct from s.lot_id
    union all
    select u.product_id,u.location_id,u.bin_id,count(*)::bigint,
      count(*) filter(where h.serial_number is not null)::bigint,
      count(*) filter(where u.status='returned' and h.serial_number is null)::bigint
    from warehouse.inventory_units u left join held_serials h
      on h.product_id=u.product_id and h.serial_number=upper(btrim(u.serial_number))
    where u.status in ('in_stock','returned')
    group by u.product_id,u.location_id,u.bin_id
  ), physical_positions as (
    select p.product_id,p.location_id,p.bin_id,sum(p.on_hand)::bigint as on_hand,
      sum(p.held)::bigint as held,sum(p.unavailable)::bigint as unavailable
    from physical p group by p.product_id,p.location_id,p.bin_id
  ), fulfillment_demand as (
    select r.order_id,r.product_id,r.location_id,r.bin_id,r.quantity::bigint as quantity
    from warehouse.fulfillment_reservations r where r.status='active'
    union all
    select o.id,line->>'productId',o.source_location_id,o.source_bin_id,sum((line->>'quantity')::bigint)::bigint
    from warehouse.fulfillment_orders o cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(o.lines) line
    where o.status in ('allocated','picking','packing','ready')
      and not exists(select 1 from warehouse.fulfillment_reservations r
        where r.order_id=o.id and r.product_id=line->>'productId' and r.status='active')
    group by o.id,line->>'productId',o.source_location_id,o.source_bin_id
  ), fulfillment_remaining as (
    select d.product_id,d.location_id,d.bin_id,
      greatest(d.quantity-(select count(distinct u.id)
        from warehouse.fulfillment_orders o cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(o.lines) line
        cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements_text(coalesce(line->'pickedSerialNumbers','[]'::jsonb)) serial
        join warehouse.inventory_units u on u.product_id=d.product_id
          and upper(btrim(u.serial_number))=upper(btrim(serial.value)) and u.status in ('allocated','issued')
        where o.id=d.order_id and line->>'productId'=d.product_id),0)::bigint as quantity
    from fulfillment_demand d
  ), event_demand as (
    select a.product_id,a.event_id,
      coalesce(sum(a.quantity) filter(where a.status='reserved'),0)::bigint as reserved,
      coalesce(sum(a.quantity) filter(where a.status='allocated'),0)::bigint as allocated
    from warehouse.allocations a where a.status in ('reserved','allocated') group by a.product_id,a.event_id
  ), event_remaining as (
    select d.product_id,(d.reserved+greatest(d.allocated-(select count(*) from warehouse.inventory_units u
      where u.product_id=d.product_id and u.event_id=d.event_id and u.status='allocated'),0))::bigint as quantity
    from event_demand d
  ), scoped as (
    select d.product_id,d.location_id,d.bin_id,sum(d.quantity)::bigint as committed
    from fulfillment_remaining d where d.location_id is not null and d.bin_id is not null
    group by d.product_id,d.location_id,d.bin_id
  ), unscoped as (
    select d.product_id,sum(d.quantity)::bigint as committed from (
      select f.product_id,f.quantity from fulfillment_remaining f where f.location_id is null or f.bin_id is null
      union all select e.product_id,e.quantity from event_remaining e
    ) d group by d.product_id
  ), positions as (
    select coalesce(p.product_id,s.product_id) as product_id,coalesce(p.location_id,s.location_id) as location_id,
      coalesce(p.bin_id,s.bin_id) as bin_id,coalesce(p.on_hand,0)::bigint as on_hand,
      coalesce(p.held,0)::bigint as held,coalesce(p.unavailable,0)::bigint as unavailable,
      coalesce(s.committed,0)::bigint as committed
    from physical_positions p full join scoped s on s.product_id=p.product_id and s.location_id=p.location_id
      and s.bin_id is not distinct from p.bin_id
  ), valid_positions as (
    select p.* from positions p join warehouse.products product on product.id=p.product_id
      join warehouse.locations location on location.id=p.location_id
  ), totals as (
    select p.product_id,sum(p.on_hand-p.held-p.unavailable-p.committed)::bigint as free
    from valid_positions p group by p.product_id
  )
  select p.product_id||'|'||p.location_id||'|'||coalesce(p.bin_id,''),p.product_id,p.location_id,p.bin_id,
    p.on_hand,p.committed,p.held,p.unavailable,
    case when coalesce(u.committed,0)>0 or invalid.product_id is not null then 0::bigint
      else greatest(p.on_hand-p.held-p.unavailable-p.committed,0)::bigint end,
    timestamptz '1970-01-01 00:00:00+00',coalesce(u.committed,0)::bigint,
    case when invalid.product_id is not null then null::bigint else greatest(t.free-coalesce(u.committed,0),0)::bigint end,
    coalesce(u.committed,0)=0 and invalid.product_id is null,
    case when invalid.product_id is not null then 0::bigint else greatest(p.on_hand-p.held-p.unavailable-p.committed,0)::bigint end
  from valid_positions p join totals t on t.product_id=p.product_id
    left join unscoped u on u.product_id=p.product_id
    left join unverifiable_products invalid on invalid.product_id=p.product_id;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.warehouse_list_stock_change_requests(payload jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_limit integer := least(greatest(coalesce((payload->>'limit')::integer,50),1),100);
  v_status text := nullif(payload->>'status','');
  v_search text := nullif(pg_catalog.btrim(coalesce(payload->>'search','')), '');
  v_rows jsonb;
begin
  if not (core.has_cap('warehouse','approve_stock_adjustment')
    or core.has_cap('warehouse','approve_stock_adjustment_finance')) then
    raise exception 'Not authorized: warehouse stock approvals';
  end if;
  select coalesce(
    jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(listed) order by listed.requested_at desc,listed.id desc),
    '[]'::jsonb
  )
  into v_rows from (
    select request.*,
      (select supervisor_step.decided_by from core.approvals supervisor_step
        where supervisor_step.entity_type='warehouse_stock_change'
          and supervisor_step.entity_id=request.id::text and supervisor_step.step=1
          and supervisor_step.decision='approved' limit 1) as supervisor_approved_by,
      (request.requested_by <> auth.uid()
       and current_step.id is not null
       and approval_group.is_active
       and approval_group.request_status = request.status
       and ((request.status='pending_supervisor'
               and approval_group.capability='approve_stock_adjustment')
            or (request.status='pending_finance'
               and approval_group.capability='approve_stock_adjustment_finance'))
       and core.has_cap(approval_group.module,approval_group.capability)
       and exists (
          select 1 from core.user_roles membership
          join core.roles catalogue_role
            on catalogue_role.module=membership.module
           and catalogue_role.role=membership.role
          where membership.user_id=auth.uid()
            and membership.module=approval_group.module
            and membership.role=any(approval_group.member_roles)
            and catalogue_role.is_active
       )
       and not (request.status='pending_finance' and exists (
         select 1 from core.approvals supervisor_step
          where supervisor_step.entity_type='warehouse_stock_change'
            and supervisor_step.entity_id=request.id::text and supervisor_step.step=1
            and supervisor_step.decision='approved'
            and supervisor_step.decided_by=auth.uid()
       ))) as can_decide
    from warehouse.stock_change_requests request
    left join lateral (
      select approval.id,approval.approver_role
      from core.approvals approval
      where approval.entity_type='warehouse_stock_change'
        and approval.entity_id=request.id::text
        and approval.decision='pending'
      order by approval.step
      limit 1
    ) current_step on true
    left join core.approval_groups approval_group
      on approval_group.entity_type='warehouse_stock_change'
     and approval_group.group_code=current_step.approver_role
    where (v_status is null or request.status=v_status)
      and (v_search is null or request.product_id ilike '%' || v_search || '%'
        or request.reason ilike '%' || v_search || '%')
    order by request.requested_at desc,request.id desc limit v_limit
  ) listed;
  return jsonb_build_object('rows',v_rows,'next_cursor',null);
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION core.platform_previous_my_work()
 RETURNS TABLE(id text, principal_id uuid, source text, title text, description text, status text, priority text, due_at timestamp with time zone, href text, required_module text, required_capability text, source_record_exists boolean)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select
    'receipt:' || receipt.id,
    auth.uid(),
    'warehouse',
    'Inspect receipt ' || receipt.id,
    'Receipt evidence and line disposition require quality review.',
    receipt.quality_status,
    'high',
    receipt.created_at + interval '1 day',
    '/warehouse/quality',
    'warehouse',
    'inspect_quality',
    true
  from warehouse.receipts receipt
  where core.has_live_cap('warehouse', 'inspect_quality')
    and receipt.quality_status in ('pending', 'partial')
  union all
  select
    'count:' || cycle_count.id,
    auth.uid(),
    'warehouse',
    'Review cycle count ' || cycle_count.id,
    'A submitted stock count requires variance review.',
    cycle_count.status,
    'high',
    coalesce(cycle_count.submitted_at, cycle_count.created_at) + interval '1 day',
    '/warehouse/cycle-counts',
    'warehouse',
    'approve_stock_adjustment',
    true
  from warehouse.cycle_counts cycle_count
  where core.has_live_cap('warehouse', 'approve_stock_adjustment')
    and cycle_count.status in ('submitted', 'pending_approval')
  union all
  select
    'request:' || request.id::text,
    auth.uid(),
    'procurement',
    'Review purchase request ' || request.id::text,
    request.title,
    request.status,
    'normal',
    request.updated_at + interval '2 days',
    '/procurement/approvals',
    'procurement',
    'approve_request',
    true
  from procurement.requests request
  where core.has_live_cap('procurement', 'approve_request')
    and request.status in ('submitted', 'under_review')
  union all
  select
    'legal:' || accreditation.id::text,
    auth.uid(),
    'legal',
    'Review vendor accreditation',
    'The submitted vendor case needs a legal determination.',
    accreditation.status,
    'normal',
    coalesce(accreditation.submitted_at, accreditation.created_at) + interval '3 days',
    '/legal/accreditation',
    'legal',
    'review_accreditation',
    true
  from legal.accreditation_cases accreditation
  where core.has_live_cap('legal', 'review_accreditation')
    and accreditation.status in ('submitted', 'under_review')
  union all
  select
    'payment:' || payment_pack.id::text,
    auth.uid(),
    'finance',
    'Review payment readiness pack',
    'A reconciled acceptance and invoice pack is ready for Finance.',
    payment_pack.status,
    'high',
    payment_pack.prepared_at + interval '2 days',
    '/procurement/purchase-orders/' || payment_pack.purchase_order_id,
    'procurement',
    'view_finance',
    true
  from procurement.payment_readiness_packs payment_pack
  where core.has_live_cap('procurement', 'view_finance')
    and payment_pack.status = 'ready_for_finance'
  union all
  select
    'event:' || event.id,
    auth.uid(),
    'events',
    'Confirm event fulfillment: ' || event.name,
    'Review reservations, issue readiness, and the return plan.',
    'planned',
    'normal',
    event.start_date::timestamptz - interval '1 day',
    '/events/' || event.id,
    'events',
    'view_events',
    true
  from warehouse.events event
  where core.has_live_cap('events', 'view_events')
    and event.start_date between current_date and current_date + 30;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.warehouse_inventory_position_for_tasks()
 RETURNS SETOF warehouse.inventory_position_v1
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if auth.uid() is not null and (
    core.has_live_cap('warehouse','view_inventory') or core.has_live_cap('warehouse','view_analytics')
    or core.has_live_cap('warehouse','view_finance') or core.has_live_cap('insights','view_warehouse')
  ) is true then
    return query select * from private.warehouse_inventory_position_summary();
  end if;
end $function$

views.definition:
SELECT id,
    product_id,
    location_id,
    bin_id,
    on_hand,
    committed,
    held,
    unavailable,
    available,
    created_at,
    unscoped_committed,
    product_available,
    availability_verified,
    putaway_available
   FROM private.warehouse_inventory_position_summary() warehouse_inventory_position_summary(id, product_id, location_id, bin_id, on_hand, committed, held, unavailable, available, created_at, unscoped_committed, product_available, availability_verified, putaway_available);

SELECT id,
    source_type,
    source_id,
    product_id,
    procurement_po_line_id,
    bin_id,
    lot_id,
    serial_number,
    quantity,
    disposition,
    reason,
    inspected_by,
    inspected_at,
        CASE
            WHEN (jsonb_typeof(evidence_urls) = 'array'::text) THEN jsonb_array_length(evidence_urls)
            ELSE 0
        END AS evidence_count
   FROM warehouse.quality_inspections;

WITH staging AS (
         SELECT "position".id,
            "position".product_id,
            "position".location_id,
            "position".bin_id,
            "position".on_hand,
            "position".committed,
            "position".held,
            "position".unavailable,
            "position".putaway_available,
            "position".created_at
           FROM (private.warehouse_inventory_position_for_tasks() "position"(id, product_id, location_id, bin_id, on_hand, committed, held, unavailable, available, created_at, unscoped_committed, product_available, availability_verified, putaway_available)
             JOIN warehouse.locations location ON ((location.id = "position".location_id)))
          WHERE (("position".bin_id IS NULL) AND ("position".putaway_available > 0) AND (location.type = 'warehouse'::text) AND (core.has_cap('warehouse'::text, 'inspect_quality'::text) OR core.has_cap('warehouse'::text, 'view_exceptions'::text) OR core.has_cap('warehouse'::text, 'view_finance'::text)))
        ), eligible_units AS (
         SELECT unit.id,
            unit.product_id,
            unit.serial_number,
            unit.lot_id,
            unit.location_id,
            unit.status,
            unit.assigned_to,
            unit.event_id,
            unit.bin_id,
            staging.putaway_available,
            row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY unit.product_id, unit.location_id ORDER BY unit.id) AS ordinal
           FROM (warehouse.inventory_units unit
             JOIN staging ON (((staging.product_id = unit.product_id) AND (staging.location_id = unit.location_id))))
          WHERE ((unit.bin_id IS NULL) AND (unit.status = 'in_stock'::text) AND (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM warehouse.inventory_holds hold
                  WHERE ((hold.product_id = unit.product_id) AND (hold.location_id = unit.location_id) AND (hold.bin_id IS NULL) AND (hold.status = 'active'::text) AND ((hold.serial_number IS NULL) OR (hold.serial_number = unit.serial_number)))))))
        )
 SELECT ('quality-'::text || (inspection.id)::text) AS id,
    'quality'::text AS task_type,
    (inspection.id)::text AS source_id,
    'Inspect receipt stock'::text AS title,
    'due'::text AS status,
    NULL::uuid AS assignee_id,
    (inspection.inspected_at + '1 day'::interval) AS due_at,
    NULL::timestamp with time zone AS completed_at,
    inspection.inspected_at AS created_at
   FROM warehouse.quality_inspections inspection
  WHERE (inspection.disposition = 'pending'::text)
UNION ALL
 SELECT ('exception-'::text || (exception.id)::text) AS id,
    'exception'::text AS task_type,
    (exception.id)::text AS source_id,
    ('Resolve '::text || replace(exception.exception_type, '_'::text, ' '::text)) AS title,
        CASE
            WHEN (exception.status = 'in_progress'::text) THEN 'blocked'::text
            ELSE 'due'::text
        END AS status,
    exception.owner_id AS assignee_id,
    exception.due_at,
    NULL::timestamp with time zone AS completed_at,
    exception.created_at
   FROM warehouse.exceptions exception
  WHERE (exception.status = ANY (ARRAY['open'::text, 'in_progress'::text]))
UNION ALL
 SELECT ('putaway-unit-'::text || unit.id) AS id,
    'putaway'::text AS task_type,
    unit.id AS source_id,
    ((('Put away '::text || product.name) || ' / '::text) || unit.serial_number) AS title,
    'due'::text AS status,
    NULL::uuid AS assignee_id,
    NULL::timestamp with time zone AS due_at,
    NULL::timestamp with time zone AS completed_at,
    '1970-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone AS created_at
   FROM (eligible_units unit
     JOIN warehouse.products product ON (((product.id = unit.product_id) AND product.serialized)))
  WHERE (unit.ordinal <= unit.putaway_available)
UNION ALL
 SELECT ('putaway-staging:'::text || (json_build_array(staging.product_id, staging.location_id))::text) AS id,
    'putaway'::text AS task_type,
    ('staging:'::text || (json_build_array(staging.product_id, staging.location_id))::text) AS source_id,
    (((('Put away '::text || product.name) || ' / '::text) || (staging.putaway_available)::text) || ' units'::text) AS title,
    'due'::text AS status,
    NULL::uuid AS assignee_id,
    NULL::timestamp with time zone AS due_at,
    NULL::timestamp with time zone AS completed_at,
    '1970-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone AS created_at
   FROM (staging
     JOIN warehouse.products product ON (((product.id = staging.product_id) AND (NOT product.serialized))));
